svg.title: British Columbia / Department of Forests / Constable
svg.desc: Clean designed reconstruction of the photographed badge. Smooth geometry and outlined type replace all image-derived contours. Relief, hammered grain, ageing, reflections and display stands are omitted. Exact original typeface, die engraving and material tones cannot be authenticated; the few silver/bronze fills are a material interpretation. The closed crown and jewel band are designed from the visible structure; fine jewel and floral engraving is unresolved.
